title: Words
summary: A dictionary of the project's own words, read from the glossary grill-with-docs keeps. Nodes carry words; a Words layer shows them and, when a word is picked, ties every node that carries it. A second shelf explains cornfield's own AI coding words to newcomers.

add.label: glossary.js
add.desc: Reads the project's glossary (GLOSSARY.md, or one per area from GLOSSARY-MAP.md): each word, its meaning, its section and the words to avoid. Never runs anything it reads.

add.label: words.js
add.desc: The Words layer: each node's words as chips, and the ties from a picked word to every node that carries it.

add.label: dictionary.js
add.desc: The dictionary: this project's words by section, and the AI coding shelf that explains cornfield's own words. A word picks its nodes; a tagged node selects it.

set.desc: The topology's shape: kinds, their colours and fields, and a node's optional words.
Checks a topology against its schema, and every word a node carries against the glossary.

change.why: an unknown word is reported like an unknown type

set.desc: The Layers menu: the map's layers, the Words layer among them, and in the Work view one layer per kind of work.
What is selected: a node with its words, or a piece of work with what it is connected to and its actions.

change.why: a node shows its words, the word to use instead of one to avoid, and a thread to ask about it
